verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are only implied, never documented. Jira advertises rich APIs and custom automation rules that move work forward, and community users praise JQL querying over REST and writing API wrapper scripts. Together these suggest an AI-native user could select many items and script changes across them, but no evidence shows a native bulk-edit or bulk-transition capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk edit, transition, or delete across many issues; bulk API endpoints; hands-on corroboration of multi-item changes via API, automation or MCP.
